Free Classroom Finder User Manual for Students Version 1.0
1. About SRCC Free Classroom Finder

The SRCC Free Classroom Finder is an open academic navigation platform built to resolve one of the most persistent daily challenges faced by students at Shri Ram College of Commerce: locating available, vacant classrooms for Group Discussions (GD), society rehearsals, case-study competitions, tutorial catch-ups, and peer study sessions.

Covering all 96 instructional rooms across the campus (including Main Building lecture halls, Tutorial wings, Principal Bungalow, Sports Complex, and Computer Labs) and tracking 210 faculty schedules across 9 daily periods, the platform synthesizes complex scheduling information into an intuitive, real-time portal. Timetable data is synchronized directly from the official college timetable portal (srcccollegetimetable.in), guaranteeing verified accuracy.

The platform operates with zero required logins, instant loading, complete offline capability, and progressive web app (PWA) installation for Android and iOS smartphones.

2. Access and Progressive Web App (PWA) Setup

The portal can be accessed directly from any modern web browser on desktop, tablet, or smartphone devices:

Website URL: https://srcc-free-classrooms.netlify.app/

Figure 1: Portal Landing Page on Mobile Web
Page 3 of 12
Free Classroom Finder User Manual for Students Version 1.0
Installing as a Progressive Web App (PWA):

Installing the application directly to your mobile home screen provides an app-like fullscreen experience, instant offline caching, and faster load times without requiring an app store account.

For Android Devices (Google Chrome / Brave / Edge):

  1. Open the website in your browser: https://srcc-free-classrooms.netlify.app/.
  2. Tap the "Install SRCC Rooms" prompt banner that appears at the bottom of the screen, or tap the three dots (⋮) in the top-right corner of your browser.
  3. Select "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
  4. Tap Install to confirm. The official centenary icon will appear on your device launcher.

For iOS Devices (Apple Safari):

  1. Open the portal URL in Safari.
  2. Tap the Share button (box with an upward arrow) at the bottom toolbar.
  3. Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
  4. Tap Add in the top-right corner. The app icon will be pinned to your home screen.
Official Standalone Android App (APK):

For students desiring native home screen widgets, the precompiled Android APK can be downloaded directly from the portal's Timetable strip via the "⬇️ App APK" button or installed via the repository releases.

Figure 2: PWA Installation & Home Screen Setup Prompt

3. Dashboard and Navigation

The user interface is structured for high-speed interaction on mobile screens. The top header features authentic college branding: the official SRCC Crest and the Centenary 100 Years Logo, alongside a live sync status indicator displaying "College Timetable Synced: Today (Daily Verified)".

Figure 3: Category & Wing Filter
Figure 4: Room Cards Overview

The Top Dual-Mode Switcher allows seamless 1-tap switching across three primary modules:

  • 🏛️ Classrooms: Comprehensive vacancy scanner across all 96 college rooms.
  • 👨‍🏫 Faculty: Teacher directory, lecture status, timetable, and verified email contact.
  • 📅 Timetable: Full student schedule explorer by Course, Semester, Section, and Batch.

Below the mode switcher, the Day Picker lets students inspect schedules for any day from Monday to Saturday. The Category Pills filter rooms by architectural wing: Principal Bungalow (PB), Tutorial Rooms (T), Sports Complex (SCR), Main Building Classrooms (R), and Computer Labs (CL).

Page 5 of 12
Free Classroom Finder User Manual for Students Version 1.0
4. Classroom Vacancy Locator (Flagship Feature)

The Classroom Vacancy Locator calculates room status period-by-period for all 9 academic periods of the college day (from Period 1: 8:30 AM to Period 9: 6:00 PM). Each room card displays:

  • Room Code & Wing: Floor level, building wing (e.g. Front Wing, Canteen Building, PB Lawn), and seating capacity.
  • 9-Period Breakdown Pills: Color-coded micro-pills (P1 to P9) providing an immediate visual scan of busy vs empty slots.
  • Active Vacancy Summary: Explicit tags indicating free periods (e.g. "Free Periods: Period 3, Period 4, Period 6").
  • Bonus Free Slot Indicators: Highlights classrooms freed up due to officially recorded faculty leaves.
☕ Universal Lunch Recess (1:30 PM – 2:00 PM): During recess, the platform dynamically displays a notification callout confirming that all 96 classrooms and tutorial rooms are open for group discussions and lunch.
5. "Free Right Now" Real-Time Quick-Toggle

Located directly in the header strip, the ⚡ Free Right Now switch automatically detects the current college period based on device clock time. Flipping the toggle to ON instantly filters out all occupied rooms, presenting only rooms that are vacant right at this moment.

Figure 5: "Free Right Now" Real-Time Quick-Toggle Active

6. Room Occupancy Timeline & Schedule Breakdown

Tapping any room card opens the Room Occupancy Timeline Modal. It presents a complete chronological table of all 9 periods for that specific room:

  • Occupied Slots: Displays the subject name, course semester, section, and the scheduled professor (with 1-tap link to open their faculty timetable).
  • Vacant Slots: Marked with a bold green badge (Empty / Free for GD) confirming the room is officially unscheduled.
  • Day Tabs: Switch between Monday to Saturday without leaving the dialog.
  • Action Toolbar: Includes "📸 Save Day Schedule" (exports a clean PNG card to photo gallery) and "📤 Share Room" (instant WhatsApp vacancy sharing).
Figure 6: Room Schedule Timeline
Figure 7: Faculty Locator Search
7. Faculty Locator & Teacher Directory (210 Faculty)

Switching to the Faculty tab opens the comprehensive directory of all 210 faculty members across Commerce, Economics, Mathematics, English, Political Science, Physical Education, EVS, and Hindi. Students can filter by department or search by professor name or teacher code (e.g., CG16, SVK, MTS).

8. Faculty Contact Details & Verified Email Copy

Each faculty member card includes an inline email action chip. Tapping the email icon opens the dedicated Faculty Contact Modal featuring:

  • Official verified University of Delhi academic email (@srcc.du.ac.in).
  • Teacher code, department badge, and initials avatar.
  • "📋 Copy Email" chip: Copies the official address cleanly to clipboard with a confirmation toast, eliminating raw email typos and avoiding accidental external mail app launches.
  • "↗️ Open Mail" button for drafting messages directly in your email client.
Figure 8: Faculty Email Contact
Figure 9: Faculty Timetable Modal
9. Faculty Weekly Timetable & Profile Share

Tapping a teacher's card opens their full Weekly Timetable Modal. Students can review the professor's scheduled lectures, tutorial batches, and assigned room numbers from Monday to Saturday. Tapping any room in the teacher's schedule immediately jumps to that room's vacancy card. The "📤 Share Faculty Profile" button generates a clean WhatsApp profile link for batch coordination.

10. Recorded Faculty Leaves & Bonus Vacant Rooms

When faculty members are on leave, their assigned classrooms often sit empty and unused. The Faculty Leaves module connects official absence notices directly with the Classroom Finder:

  • Classes scheduled under an absent teacher are dynamically unlocked as "Bonus Vacant Slots" for self-study.
  • Tapping the "🏖️ Active Leaves" header pill opens the Leave Directory, listing absent professors, dates, and affected lecture periods.
  • The "💬 Share All List" button generates a formatted absence summary for CRs and batch WhatsApp groups.
Figure 10: Faculty Leaves Directory
Figure 11: Student Timetable Explorer
11. Student Academic Timetable Explorer

The Timetable tab allows students to view complete official class schedules across all programs: B.Com (Hons) (Sections A to N), B.A. (Hons) Economics (Sections A to D), and interdisciplinary SEC / VAC courses across Semesters I, III, V, and VII. Selecting your course, section, and tutorial batch renders all daily lectures, teachers, and rooms in chronological sequence.

12. Campus Wi-Fi Credentials Directory

To assist students experiencing cellular connectivity dead zones inside basement labs or thick-walled heritage blocks, the header features a dedicated WiFi Directory. It stores verified credentials for 24 campus Wi-Fi networks:

  • Categorized by frequency band: ⚡ 5G High Speed, 📶 4G Standard, 🏛️ Principal Bungalow, and 🏢 Main Building.
  • Displays exact network SSID, location coverage, and security protocol.
  • 1-Tap Password Copy: Instantly copies the network password to clipboard.
  • Scan QR Code: Generates a standard Wi-Fi QR code for automatic camera connection on Android and iOS devices.
Figure 12: Campus Wi-Fi Directory
Figure 13: Group Study Reminder
13. Group Study Coordination & Calendar Reminders

When securing an empty room for a society rehearsal or case discussion, students can tap the calendar bell icon on any vacant period card to open the Group Study Reminder Modal. It provides a direct Google Calendar link (with a 15-minute advance alert), an Apple / Outlook .ics file download, and a formatted WhatsApp GD Invite generator.

14. Android Interactive Home Screen Widgets & APK

The platform includes dedicated companion widget options for home screen access without opening a browser:

  • Standalone Web Widget (widget.html): A dedicated lightweight schedule widget that saves your course, section, and batch offline for immediate glanceable schedule access.
  • Android Native Home Screen Widgets: Pre-built Android app package providing three distinct widget formats:
    • 4x1 Next Class Pill: Displays your upcoming lecture, room code, and teacher.
    • 4x2 Daily Timeline: Scrollable list of today's remaining classes.
    • 4x4 Academic Dashboard: Combines room vacancy scanner and personal schedule.
Figure 14: Widget Setup
Figure 15: Issue Reporting Modal
15. Offline Support, Keyboard Shortcuts & Issue Reporting

The app incorporates a Service Worker caching engine, ensuring the full timetable and room database function seamlessly in offline mode. Desktop users can press / to focus search inputs and Esc to close any modal. The header ⚠️ Report button enables students to flag timetable discrepancies or room changes for immediate verification.

Disclaimer

The SRCC Free Classroom Finder is an independent student academic facilitation project designed to simplify classroom discovery, peer study coordination, and timetable navigation. Class schedules and faculty assignments are sourced directly from the official Shri Ram College of Commerce timetable portal (srcccollegetimetable.in).

This platform does not supersede official college notifications, room requisition circulars, or administrative orders issued by the Principal's Office or the Timetable Committee (TTC). Classroom vacancy indicated by the application reflects unscheduled instructional hours; official administrative bookings, departmental tests, and sanctioned events take precedence at all times.
